name: B10-0259/2026 (The Left) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop repressing its people and to release all political prisoners, including Narges Mohammadi. It condemns the sharp rise in executions and opposes the death penalty, urging a moratorium as a first step. It also condemns US and Israeli air strikes on Iran that killed civilians, and criticises the EU's top diplomat for not clearly condemning them. It asks the EU to use targeted sanctions instead of broad economic ones. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament states its position and makes requests.
- It addresses Iran's authorities, the EU and its member states, and the US and Israel.
- Next, the resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states and Iran's authorities.
